example.en: Please cancel the order before it ships.
example.zh: 请在发货前取消这个订单。

example.en: They live in a remote village in the mountains.
example.zh: 他们住在山里一个偏远的村庄。

example.en: We spent the afternoon exploring the old town.
example.zh: 我们花了一个下午探索这座老城。

example.en: Regular exercise brings many health benefits.
example.zh: 经常锻炼会带来许多健康益处。

example.en: She worked hard to achieve her goals.
example.zh: 她努力工作以实现自己的目标。

example.en: It was obvious that he was telling the truth.
I am grateful for your kind help.
example.zh: 我非常感激你的热心帮助。

name: essential
trans: 必要的；必不可少的；本质的

example.en: Water is essential for all living things.
example.zh: 水对所有生物都是必不可少的。

example.en: The child was curious about everything around him.
example.zh: 这个孩子对周围的一切都感到好奇。

example.en: Practice every day to improve your English.
example.zh: 每天练习以提高你的英语水平。

example.en: He didn't mention the problem at the meeting.
example.zh: 他在会上没有提到这个问题。

example.en: This is only a temporary solution.
example.zh: 这只是一个临时的解决办法。

example.en: She answered the question with confidence.
example.zh: 她充满信心地回答了问题。

example.en: We should do our best to protect the environment.
example.zh: 我们应该尽最大努力保护环境。

example.en: I suggest we leave early tomorrow morning.
example.zh: 我建议我们明天一早出发。

example.en: Good habits can prevent many diseases.
example.zh: 良好的习惯可以预防许多疾病。

example.en: Robots may replace humans in some jobs.
example.zh: 机器人可能会取代人类从事某些工作。

example.en: The store sells various kinds of fruit.
example.zh: 这家商店出售各种各样的水果。

example.en: She is an independent and confident young woman.
example.zh: 她是一个独立自信的年轻女性。
